patthana15.23:1.1: sahetukaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sahetuko na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana15.23:2.1: sahetukaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sahetuko na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana15.23:3.1: ahetukaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na ahetuko na abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ. hetusampayuttaduka kusalattike nahetusampayuttaduka nakusalattikaṃ
